entries.3cbcffc1bbcc6442: A service that provides client companies with an SMS and RCS delivery platform. Client companies operate the Company's delivery management screen or use an API (a mechanism that connects pieces of software) to deliver SMS and RCS to general consumers' mobile devices through mobile carriers' networks. It is used for identity verification, business communications such as notifying registered temporary staff of interview dates, reservation confirmations and shipping notices, promotions, and payment reminders to delinquent customers. Revenue consists of initial customization fees and monthly usage fees based on the number of messages delivered and similar factors. Costs include the fees paid to mobile carriers for SMS and RCS delivery and server usage fees. In the sales results table, it is the largest category in the sales of the Smart AI Engagement Business, and the year-on-year figure was 106.97%.
